# What each setting really does, for the settings assistant (the local AI).
#   variable: description (what it does, what the values mean)
#   variable: -          = never offered by the assistant (leftover, internal)
# The assistant sees these with the current value and the limits.
# The part after the docs mark (end of file) is generated by
# tools/assistant-settings-docs.py from docs/*.html; edit the part above.

# --- colours (friends, me) ---
mycolor: colour of my own body and name. -1 none, 0 green, 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 grey, 5 magenta, 6 orange, 7 white, 8 cyan, 9 pink
friendallycolor: colour of my friends who are on my team (name and body). -1 none, 0 green, 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 grey, 5 magenta, 6 orange, 7 white, 8 cyan, 9 pink
friendenemycolor: colour of my friends who are on the other team or in free for all (name and body). -1 none, 0 green, 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 grey, 5 magenta, 6 orange, 7 white, 8 cyan, 9 pink
friendcolor: -
teamcolorally: colour of every teammate's body, bots included (team games; replaces blue). -1 none (blue), 0 green, 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 grey, 5 magenta, 6 orange, 7 white, 8 cyan, 9 pink
teamcolorenemy: colour of every enemy's body, bots included (replaces red in team games; everyone else in free for all). -1 none, 0 green, 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 grey, 5 magenta, 6 orange, 7 white, 8 cyan, 9 pink
friendsfollowteamcolor: 1 = friends' bodies take the teammate / enemy colour instead of the friend colours (names keep them)
customplayermodel: 1 = use my own model from packages/models/custom in my profile (no colour skin on it; the picked model if the folder is empty)
clantag: my clan tag, used to recognise clan mates as friends (text)
friendaddname: -
playermodel: my player model. 0 Mr Fixit, 1 Snout X10K, 2 Ogro, 3 Inky, 4 Captain Cannon
forceplayermodels: 1 = everyone is shown with my player model
teamskins: 1 = always use blue (my team) / red (others) skins, even outside team games
fullbrightmodels: lights players whatever the light of the map. 0 off, 60 subtle, 100 bright, 150 overbright, 200 max
teamcolorfrags: team colours in frag messages
teamcolortext: team colours for player names in the console
teamcolorchat: team colours for names in the chat
teamsounds: different sounds for teammates

# --- weapon trails (local look only) ---
trailcolorshotgun: All - colour used for every shot unless Me / Others has its own: colour of the shotgun trails as a hex RGB value, e.g. trailcolorshotgun 0x60F0FF (stock 0xFFC864). Also: settrailcolor SG "#60F0FF", settrailcolor SG stock
trailcolorchaingun: All - colour used for every shot unless Me / Others has its own: colour of the chaingun trails as a hex RGB value (stock 0xFFC864). Also: settrailcolor CG "#RRGGBB"
trailcolorrifle: All - colour used for every shot unless Me / Others has its own: colour of the rifle smoke trail as a hex RGB value (stock 0x404040 dark grey). Also: settrailcolor RI "#RRGGBB"
trailcolorrocketlauncher: All - colour used for every shot unless Me / Others has its own: colour of the smoke behind rockets as a hex RGB value (stock 0x404040). Also: settrailcolor RL "#RRGGBB"
trailcolorgrenadelauncher: All - colour used for every shot unless Me / Others has its own: colour of the smoke behind grenades as a hex RGB value (stock 0x404040). Also: settrailcolor GL "#RRGGBB"
trailcolorpistol: All - colour used for every shot unless Me / Others has its own: colour of the pistol trails as a hex RGB value (stock 0xFFC864). Also: settrailcolor PI "#RRGGBB"
trailmycolorshotgun: colour of the shotgun trails of MY shots as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorshotgun). Also: settrailcolor me SG "#RRGGBB" / same
trailmycolorchaingun: colour of the chaingun trails of MY shots as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorchaingun). Also: settrailcolor me CG "#RRGGBB" / same
trailmycolorrifle: colour of the rifle trails of MY shots as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorrifle). Also: settrailcolor me RI "#RRGGBB" / same
trailmycolorrocketlauncher: colour of the rocket trails of MY shots as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorrocketlauncher). Also: settrailcolor me RL "#RRGGBB" / same
trailmycolorgrenadelauncher: colour of the grenade trails of MY shots as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorgrenadelauncher). Also: settrailcolor me GL "#RRGGBB" / same
trailmycolorpistol: colour of the pistol trails of MY shots as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorpistol). Also: settrailcolor me PI "#RRGGBB" / same
trailothercolorshotgun: colour of the shotgun trails of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team, no team distinction) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorshotgun). Also: settrailcolor others SG "#RRGGBB" / same
trailothercolorchaingun: colour of the chaingun trails of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team, no team distinction) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorchaingun). Also: settrailcolor others CG "#RRGGBB" / same
trailothercolorrifle: colour of the rifle trails of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team, no team distinction) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorrifle). Also: settrailcolor others RI "#RRGGBB" / same
trailothercolorrocketlauncher: colour of the rocket trails of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team, no team distinction) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorrocketlauncher). Also: settrailcolor others RL "#RRGGBB" / same
trailothercolorgrenadelauncher: colour of the grenade trails of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team, no team distinction) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorgrenadelauncher). Also: settrailcolor others GL "#RRGGBB" / same
trailothercolorpistol: colour of the pistol trails of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team, no team distinction) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (trailcolorpistol). Also: settrailcolor others PI "#RRGGBB" / same
trailbrightness: brightness of the custom trail colours in percent (25 to 100); stock colours are never changed
projcolorrocketlauncher: All - projectile and explosion colour of rockets for every shot unless Me / Others has its own (separate from the smoke trail): a glow of that colour on the rocket in flight and a recoloured explosion; with RT the rocket's and explosion's light take it. Hex RGB value, -1 = stock look (orange explosion). Also: setprojcolor RL "#RRGGBB", setprojcolor RL stock
projcolorgrenadelauncher: All - projectile and explosion colour of grenades for every shot unless Me / Others has its own (separate from the smoke trail); with RT their light takes it. Hex RGB value, -1 = stock look (cyan explosion). Also: setprojcolor GL "#RRGGBB", setprojcolor GL stock
projmycolorrocketlauncher: projectile and explosion colour of MY rockets as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (projcolorrocketlauncher). Also: setprojcolor me RL "#RRGGBB" / same
projmycolorgrenadelauncher: projectile and explosion colour of MY grenades as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (projcolorgrenadelauncher). Also: setprojcolor me GL "#RRGGBB" / same
projothercolorrocketlauncher: projectile and explosion colour of the rockets of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (projcolorrocketlauncher). Also: setprojcolor others RL "#RRGGBB" / same
projothercolorgrenadelauncher: projectile and explosion colour of the grenades of EVERY OTHER player and bot (any team) as a hex RGB value; -1 = same as All (projcolorgrenadelauncher). Also: setprojcolor others GL "#RRGGBB" / same; projcolorreset = all projectile colours back to stock

# --- crosshair ---
crosshairsize: size of the crosshair, 0 = hidden
crosshairfx: crosshair effects: hit marker, teammate crosshair, health colours (off = always the plain white crosshair)
crosshaircolors: crosshair turns orange/red when health is low
crosshaircolour: resting colour of the crosshair as a hex RGB value, e.g. crosshaircolour 0x00FF00 (default 0xFFFFFF white). Hit, teammate and low-health tints still override it. Also settable with: crosshairhex "#00FF00"
teamcrosshair: special crosshair when aiming at a teammate
hitcrosshair: how long the hit crosshair stays after hitting someone, in milliseconds (0 = off). It takes the colour of the player hit
crosshairreloaddim: 1 = crosshair at half brightness while the weapon reloads
cursorsize: size of the mouse cursor in menus

# --- HUD ---
hudgun: show my weapon in first person
hudgunsway: my weapon sways when moving
teamhudguns: first person weapon in team colour
chainsawhudgun: show the chainsaw in first person
muzzleflash: flash at the gun barrel when shooting
muzzlelight: light at the gun barrel when shooting
muzzlelightshotgun: light of the shotgun muzzle flash on walls, floor, players and the gun, for every player (me and the others), classic lighting and ray tracing: 1 on (default), 0 off (the flash sprite at the barrel stays)
muzzlelightchaingun: light of the chaingun muzzle flash on walls, floor, players and the gun, for every player (me and the others), classic lighting and ray tracing: 1 on (default), 0 off (the flash sprite at the barrel stays)
muzzlelightrifle: light of the rifle muzzle flash on walls, floor, players and the gun, for every player (me and the others), classic lighting and ray tracing: 1 on (default), 0 off (the flash sprite at the barrel stays)
muzzlelightgrenadelauncher: light of the grenade launcher muzzle flash on walls, floor, players and the gun, for every player (me and the others), classic lighting and ray tracing: 1 on (default), 0 off (the flash sprite at the barrel stays)
muzzlelightpistol: light of the pistol muzzle flash on walls, floor, players and the gun, for every player (me and the others), classic lighting and ray tracing: 1 on (default), 0 off (the flash sprite at the barrel stays)
healthcolors: health number changes colour when low
ammohud: ammo icons on the HUD
statusicons: health/armour/ammo icons at the bottom of the screen
statusbars: health bars above teammates. 0 off, 1 teammates, 2 teammates and everyone when spectating
statusbarscale: size of those health bars
damagescreen: red screen flash when taking damage
damagecompass: -
showfps: show frames per second
showfpsrange: show the min/max FPS range too
wallclock: show the real time (clock)
wallclock24: 24-hour clock
wallclocksecs: clock with seconds
deathscore: show the scoreboard automatically when I die
showmodeinfo: show the game mode description when the game starts
outlinemeters: outline around capture meters
flagfeed: CTF: big messages in the middle top of the screen when a flag is stolen, picked up or scored (with the run time)
flagfeedfade: seconds a big flag message stays
flagtimer: CTF: timer at the bottom right while I (or the player I watch) carry a flag stolen from the enemy base (not one picked up from the ground)
basenumbers: numbers on capture bases
capturetether: -
autorepammo: in capture, take ammo automatically at my team's bases
radarteammates: teammates on the radar/minimap
minimapalpha: opacity of the minimap
conscale: size of the console text
# ammo bar
ammobar: show the ammo bar (all weapons and their ammo)
ammobaralign: ammo bar alignment. -1 left, 0 centre, 1 right
ammobarhorizontal: 1 = horizontal ammo bar, 0 = vertical
ammobarflip: ammo count on the other side of the icon
ammobarhideempty: hide weapons with no ammo
ammobarscale: size of the ammo bar
ammobarcountscale: size of the ammo numbers
ammobarx: horizontal position of the ammo bar (0 left .. 1 right)
ammobary: vertical position of the ammo bar (0 top .. 1 bottom)
ammobarsep: space between weapons in the ammo bar
ammobarcountsep: space between icon and number
# game clock
gameclock: show the time left in the match
gameclockscale: size of the match clock
gameclockalign: match clock alignment. -1 left, 0 centre, 1 right
gameclockx: horizontal position of the match clock (0 left .. 1 right)
gameclocky: vertical position of the match clock (0 top .. 1 bottom)
gameclockalpha: opacity of the match clock (0..255)
gameclockcolour: colour of the match clock (hex, 0xFFFFFF white)
gameclocklowcolour: colour of the match clock in the last minute (hex)
# HUD score
hudscore: show the team / my score on screen during the match
hudscorescale: size of the on-screen score
hudscorealign: on-screen score alignment. -1 left, 0 centre, 1 right
hudscorex: horizontal position of the on-screen score (0 left .. 1 right)
hudscorey: vertical position of the on-screen score (0 top .. 1 bottom)
hudscorealpha: opacity of the on-screen score (0..255)
hudscoresep: space between the two scores
hudscoreplayercolour: colour of my score (hex)
hudscoreenemycolour: colour of the enemy score (hex)
# kill feed
killfeed: list of recent frags on screen (who killed who)
killfeedconsole: also write frags in the console
killfeedfilter: which frags the kill feed shows. 0 all, 1 my team's, 2 only mine
killfeedalign: kill feed alignment. -1 left, 0 centre, 1 right
killfeedx: horizontal position of the kill feed (0 left .. 1 right)
killfeedy: vertical position of the kill feed (0 top .. 1 bottom)
killfeedscale: size of the kill feed
killfeedfade: seconds before a kill feed line fades
killfeedmax: number of lines in the kill feed
reacttime: reaction times (view / crosshair, in ms) on my kills and deaths in the kill feed
reacttimeall: also the reaction times of frags between other players, measured by their killer (compatible server, killer with reacttime on). 0 off (default), 1 on
killfeedvs: kills-deaths against each player, next to their name in the kill feed
# killstreak
killstreak: announce my killing sprees on screen (display only)
killstreakothers: also announce other players' sprees
killstreaktk: 1 = killing a teammate ends the spree
killstreakstep: announce every N frags (5 = at 5, 10, 15...)
killstreakfade: seconds the announcement stays
killstreakscale: size of the announcement
killstreakx: horizontal position of the announcement
killstreaky: vertical position of the announcement
killstreakalign: announcement alignment. -1 left, 0 centre, 1 right
killstreak1: -
killstreak2: -
killstreak3: -
killstreak4: -

# --- scoreboard (Tab) ---
scoreboard2d: 2D scoreboard (flat on the screen)
scoreboardalpha: opacity of the scoreboard background (0..100)
showservinfo: server name and info at the top of the scoreboard
showclientnum: client number column
showpj: packet jump column (lag)
showping: ping column. 0 hidden, 1 ping, 2 ping and packet jump
showspectators: list spectators
showspectatorping: ping of spectators
highlightscore: highlight my line
showconnecting: show players still connecting
hidefrags: hide the frags column in CTF and collect (flags count instead)
showfrags: frags column
showdeaths: deaths column
showkd: kills/deaths ratio column
showflags: flags / skulls column
showaccuracy: accuracy column
showlang: languages column (the chat languages of each player, from the translation)
showvs: "vs you" column: my kills-deaths against each player this match
showstatus: status column (dead / lagging)

# --- deaths, blood, players ---
blood: blood effects
ragdoll: bodies fall with physics (ragdolls)
ragdollmillis: how long a dead body stays, in milliseconds
ragdollfade: how long a dead body takes to fade, in milliseconds
hidedead: hide dead players. 0 show them, 1 hide them, 2 hide them but keep my own body visible when I die
deadpush: how far dead bodies are pushed by explosions
lookselfshadow: my own shadow (sun) when ray tracing is on
explodebright: brightness of explosions (0..1)
maxdebris: number of debris pieces from explosions
maxbarreldebris: number of debris pieces from barrels
decalfade: how long bullet holes and scorch marks stay (ms)
maxdecaldistance: distance up to which decals are drawn

# --- sound ---
soundvol: master volume (0..255)
musicvol: music volume (0..255)
hitsound: ping sound when I hit someone (volume: mixhits)
mixweapons: loudness of weapons (shots, explosions). 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixhits: loudness of the hit ping. 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixpain: loudness of pain and death sounds. 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixitems: loudness of item pickups. 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixannounce: loudness of announcements (quad, armour...). 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixflags: loudness of flag and skull sounds. 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixmove: loudness of footsteps, jumps and landings. 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
mixworld: loudness of map sounds (ambience). 100 normal, 0 mute, 200 double
minimizedsounds: keep playing sounds when the game is minimized
maxsoundsatonce: how many copies of the same sound can play at once
soundchans: how many sounds can play at the same time. 1 to 128, default 32. Applied when the sound restarts
soundfreq: sound mixing frequency in Hz: 11025, 22050 (default) or 44100. 3D sound sets it to 44100. Applied when the sound restarts
soundbufferlen: sound buffer length: bigger if the sound crackles or stutters, smaller for less delay. 128 to 4096, default 1024. Applied when the sound restarts
mumble: Mumble positional audio (voice chat comes from the player's position)
son3d: 3D sound (Steam Audio). 0 off (usual left/right sound), 1 headphones: HRTF, ahead/behind and above/below can be heard (sets the sound frequency to 44100 Hz), 2 speakers: usual left/right sound plus occlusion. Own sounds, menus, announcements and music never change
son3docclusion: with 3D sound on (headphones or speakers), walls between me and a sound muffle it (never muted)

# --- mouse, view ---
sensitivity: mouse sensitivity (higher = faster)
sensitivityscale: divides the sensitivity (to copy the sensitivity of another game)
mousedpi: DPI of the mouse, used with sensitivity
mouseaccel: mouse acceleration (0 = none)
invmouse: invert the mouse vertically
fov: field of view in degrees (how wide I see)
zoomfov: field of view when zoomed (rifle scope)
zoomsens: mouse sensitivity while zoomed
zoomautosens: 1 = adjust the zoomed sensitivity automatically
zoomaccel: mouse acceleration while zoomed
zoominvel: zoom-in speed (ms)
zoomoutvel: zoom-out speed (ms)
guisens: mouse speed in 3D menus

# --- display, graphics ---
gamma: brightness of the picture, in percent (100 normal, higher = brighter)
vsync: vertical sync (no tearing, a little more input lag)
lowlatency: low latency mode, the mouse is read once the GPU catches up. 0 off, 1 on (default, no FPS cost; helps most with ray tracing, native HDR or V-Sync), 2 strict (lowest latency, fewer FPS)
vsynctear: allow tearing when the frame rate drops below the refresh rate
maxfps: frame rate limit (0 = none)
windowmode: 0 windowed, 1 exclusive fullscreen, 2 borderless fullscreen
scr_w: width of the game resolution in pixels, set with scr_h by the Display > Resolution buttons (applied at once in windowed or exclusive fullscreen, and in borderless fullscreen when borderlessres is 1; otherwise borderless uses the monitor size). Typed alone, applied after restarting the game (at once in borderless with borderlessres 1)
scr_h: height of the game resolution in pixels, set with scr_w by the Display > Resolution buttons (applied at once in windowed or exclusive fullscreen, and in borderless fullscreen when borderlessres is 1; otherwise borderless uses the monitor size). Typed alone, applied after restarting the game (at once in borderless with borderlessres 1)
borderlessres: borderless fullscreen at a chosen resolution. 0 = monitor size (default), 1 = the game renders at the Display > Resolution size (scr_w x scr_h) and the picture is stretched over the whole screen, like a stretched exclusive fullscreen, without changing the Windows resolution. Works with DLSS, FSR, native, ray tracing and HDR. Not with Full-Scene Anti-Aliasing above 0 (the Display menu then hides the box and says so)
borderlessaspect: with borderlessres 1, 1 = keep the proportions of the chosen resolution (black bars), 0 = stretch over the whole screen (default)
fsaa: full-scene anti-aliasing (multisampling): -1 driver default (default), 0 off, 2, 4, 8 or 16 samples. Applied after restarting the game
depthbits: precision of the depth buffer in bits: 0 automatic, 24 bits (default), 16, 24 or 32. Applied after restarting the game
gui2d: 1 = menus drawn flat on the screen (default), 0 = menus floating in the 3D world
hdroutpref: display output. -1 automatic (HDR if Windows HDR is on), 0 SDR (default), 1 native HDR
hdroutref: HDR paper white: brightness of normal white in HDR, in nits
hdroutmax: HDR peak brightness in nits (0 = what the screen reports)
hdrouthud: brightness of the HUD and menus in HDR, in nits (0 = same as paper white)
hwrt: ray traced lighting (RTX). 1 on, 0 off (classic lighting)
hwrtngxmode: anti-aliasing / upscaling. 0 native, 1 DLAA, 2 DLSS quality, 3 DLSS balanced, 4 DLSS performance (DLAA/DLSS need an NVIDIA RTX card), 5 FSR native, 6 FSR quality, 7 FSR balanced, 8 FSR performance (AMD FSR, any graphics card)
hwrtfsrsharpness: extra sharpening after AMD FSR, 0 off to 100
hwrtnrd: denoiser for ray traced lighting
hwrtreflections: sharp ray traced reflections on water and reflective surfaces (ray tracing). 1 on, 0 off
hwrtspecular: shine of lamps and sun on glossy surfaces (ray tracing). 1 on, 0 off
hwrtdiffupscale: how small wall and floor textures are enlarged with ray tracing (blocky, shimmering steps up close otherwise). 2 bicubic (default), 3 Lanczos (a little sharper, slower map load), 0 nearest (old blocky look), 1 bilinear (softer)
hwrtdiffmipbias: detail of distant wall and floor textures with ray tracing (Graphics > RT Textures > Distance detail). 0 Stable (default, less shimmer in motion with DLAA/DLSS), -0.5 Sharper (a little more detail far away, more shimmer)
hwrtsmoothnormals: smooth lighting across faceted floors, slopes and rocks with ray tracing, like classic lighting (no light steps between faces). 1 on (default), 0 off (flat faces, the old RT look)
hwrtdynlights: muzzle flashes, rockets and grenades in flight and explosions light the walls, floor, players and my gun with ray tracing (custom colours tint the light: the trail colour for muzzle flashes, the projectile colour for rockets, grenades and their explosions). 1 on (default), 0 off (as before: these lights do not light the RT image)
hwrtshadowself: which lights cast my own shadow with ray tracing. 0 none, 1 the sun, 2 + small lights, 3 + nearest lamps, 4 + sky
hwrtteleportlight: teleporters glow and light the room (ray tracing)
hwrtjumppadlight: jump pads glow and light the room (ray tracing)
hwrtsmokeshadow: weapon smoke (rifle trail, rockets, grenades, any trail colour) casts soft shadows from the sun, lamps and sky with ray tracing. 1 on, 0 off (no smoke shadow)
hwrtsmokeshadowdensity: how dark weapon smoke shadows are, percent (ray tracing). 100 default, 10 to 400
hwrtsundisk: draw the sun disk in the sky
hwrtskytemporal: smooths sky light over several frames (higher = smoother, slower to react)
hwrtworldgain: -
hwrtdebug: -
hwrttimes: -
hwrtmask: -
hwrtdepthmask: -
hwrtdlights: -
hwrtglowdlights: -
hwrtskyrays: -
hwrtskyfilter: -
hwrtskinbudget: -
hwrtmaxinsts: -
hwrthdrexp: -
rtaoradius: -
rtaoscale: -
rtaobias: -
dlaa: -
dlss: -
dlssquality: -
gtao: ambient occlusion in classic lighting (darkens corners, wall bases and contacts with props, only the ambient and sky part of the light; never players, guns, water or effects). 0 off, 1 low (small, close occlusion), 2 high (wider). Not used with ray tracing
lookao: old "Creases" soft shadows in corners, classic lighting only and only when Ambient Occlusion (gtao) is off; no longer in the menus, never applied with ray tracing. Prefer gtao (Graphics > Lighting > Ambient Occlusion)
lookaoscale: strength of that ambient occlusion
lookaoradius: size of that ambient occlusion
looktaa: temporal anti-aliasing (smoother edges, a bit blurry)
motionblur: motion blur
motionblurscale: strength of the motion blur
motionblurmillis: -
skyboxglare: glare from the sky
aniso: anisotropic filtering (sharper textures at an angle): 0 off, 2, 4, 8, 16
bilinear: bilinear texture filtering
trilinear: trilinear texture filtering (mipmaps)
caustics: moving light patterns on the floor under water. 1 on (default), 0 off
shadowmap: soft shadows cast by players and models on the floor and walls. 0 off (default), 1 on. When off, blob shadows can be used instead
shadowmapsize: quality of the soft shadows: 9 medium (default), 10 high (7 to 11)
blobs: round dark shadow under players and items (used when soft shadows are off). 1 on (default), 0 off
glare: glow around bright lights. 0 off (default), 1 on; the Subtle / Glowy / Soft / Intense buttons set its blur and strength
depthfx: soft particles: smoke and explosions fade where they touch walls and floor instead of cutting into them. 1 on (default), 0 off
depthfxsize: quality of the soft particles: 7 low (default), 10 medium, 12 high
glassenv: reflections on glass. 1 on (default), 0 off
decals: bullet holes, scorch marks and blood splats on walls and floor. 1 on (default), 0 off; Quick Fade / Slow Fade (decalfade) choose how long they stay
envmapmodels: shiny environment reflections on models (weapons, items). 1 on (default), 0 off
bumpmodels: bump mapping (surface relief) on models. 1 on (default), 0 off
texreduce: lowers texture quality (0 = full)
maxtexsize: -
reducefilter: -
texcompress: -
texcompressquality: -
usenp2: -
gpumipmap: -
autocompactvslots: -
maxdynlights: number of dynamic lights (muzzle flashes, explosions)
dynlightdist: distance up to which dynamic lights are drawn
showparticles: particles (smoke, sparks)
particlesize: size of particles in percent
maxparticles: -
fewparticles: -
particleglare: -
maxparticledistance: distance up to which particles are drawn
maxtrail: -
particletext: floating text above players (e.g. damage)
maxparticletextdistance: -
emitmillis: -
envmapsize: -
minimapsize: -
ati_skybox_bug: -
reflectmms: -

# --- console, chat ---
consize: number of console lines shown at the top
miniconsize: lines of the mini console (chat)
miniconwidth: width of the mini console, in percent of the screen
confade: seconds before console lines fade
miniconfade: seconds before chat lines fade
fullconsize: size of the full console, percent of the screen
fullchatsize: size of the expanded chat, percent of the screen
fullkilllogsize: size of the full kill list, percent of the screen
maxcon: lines kept in the console history
maxhistory: commands kept in the command history
confilter: -
fullconfilter: -
miniconfilter: -
contags: -
rtconsole: 1 = show ray tracing messages in the console (for debugging)

# --- translation ---
translatechat: translate incoming chat into my language
translateteamchat: also translate team chat
translateauto: language of what I send. 0 off, 1 the language set in "I send in", 2 the language last spoken to me
translatepreview: preview the translation while I type
translatefemme: I am a woman: feminine grammar in translations
translatelang: the language I read (code: fr, en, de...)
translateoutlang: the language I send in (code: en, fr, de...)
translatepreviewdelay: delay before the typing preview, in ms
translatetimeout: -
texampledir: -
texamplekind: -
texamplelang: -
tmodelurl: -
tmodelkey: -
tmodelapimodel: -
texamplesrc: -
texampledst: -

# --- recording, demos ---
matchrecord: record a video of each match automatically
matchkeep: how many match videos to keep (oldest deleted)
matchrecquality: video quality. 1 720p light, 2 720p normal, 3 720p high, 4 1080p, 5 1080p high
demohdrecord: record HD demos (exact aim) along with normal demos
demohdplay: play HD demos with exact aim when available
hdlivedelay: when spectating live on a compatible server, how far in the past (ms) the exact HD aim is shown, so it plays smooth and complete; same delay for every player. Default 200, 0 to 1000
demokeep: how many demos to keep (oldest deleted)
screenshotformat: screenshot format. 0 BMP, 1 TGA, 2 PNG, 3 JPG
screenshotquality: JPG screenshot quality
compresspng: -
compresstga: -
movieminquality: -
moviesync: -

# --- menus, servers, misc ---
guiclicktab: menus switch tabs on click instead of hover
guifadein: menus fade in
guiautotab: -
guipreviewtime: -
guipushdist: -
applydialog: ask before applying settings that need a restart
autosortservers: sort the server list automatically
autoupdateservers: refresh the server list automatically
searchlan: also search LAN servers
maxservpings: -
servpingdecay: -
servpingrate: -
autoauth: log in automatically on servers that use my auth key
smoothmove: smoothing of other players' movement (0..100)
smoothdist: distance up to which movement is smoothed
spawnwait: delay before I can respawn after dying, in ms
attackspawn: fire to respawn
jumpspawn: jump to respawn

# --- from the Sauerbraten docs ---
flarecutoff: The maximum visiblity distance of a lens flare source from 0..10000. Note that visibility also depends on the viewers angle to the flare source.
flaresize: The size of the lens flare effect from 20..500.
grass: Sets grass 0..1 generated by autograss textures to be drawn.
grassdist: Sets the maximum distance 0..10000 at which grass is drawn. Higher numbers mean more grass will be drawn and be more expensive.
grassstep: Sets the step distance between rows of grass to 0.5..8. Higher step distances will look sparser, but render faster.
maxreflect: Sets the maximum number of reflection surfaces that can be visible at once from 1..8. Any surfaces exceeding this limit will not be given reflections on their surfaces.
maxroll: Sets the maximum value your display will roll on strafing from 0..20
menuautoclose: Sets the distance at which the menu is automatically closed when the player moves away from it (default 120).
menudistance: Sets the distance at which the menu is created in front of the player (default 40).
movieaccel: Enable GPU-accelerated video encoding with 1, disable with 0. This is enabled by default, but may cause problems on some video cards. If you notice movie recording displaying strange results, try disabling this and see i
moviefps: The framerate (default is 24fps) at which to record the movie. Movie recording may prematurely stop if unable to record reliably at this framerate.
movieh: The height (default is 240) of the movie (0 will use the current window height). The movie will be downsized appropriately.
moviesound: Enable recording of sound with 1, disable with 0.
moview: The width (default is 320) of the movie (0 will use the current window width). The movie will be downsized appropriately.
reflectdist: Sets the maximum distance geometry/objects can be at to be in a reflection from 0..10000.
reflectsize: Sets the resolution of reflected surfaces (where the dimensions would measure 2^N x 2^N), from 6..10. Lowering this value results in a grainier image, whereas increasing it results in a finer and mroe detailed image. Thi
shaderdetail: This sets the level of detail shaders should use, for N=3 is highest, and N=0 is lowest. Lower settings will give speedups on slower hardware.
waterenvmap: Enables or disables water environment-mapping (cheaper fake reflections). By default, this is used when "waterreflect" is turned off.
waterfade: Enables or disables soft fading of water edges. This option only works if "waterrefract" is enabled..
waterfallenv: Enables or disables environment-mapped waterfall reflections..
waterfallrefract: Enables or disables refractive waterfalls..
waterlod: Sets the precision level of the water LOD (Level of Detail) from 0..3, where 0 is the lowest and 3 is the highest setting.
waterreflect: Enables or disables water reflections.
waterrefract: Enables or disables water refractions..
watersubdiv: Determines the subdivision of the water surface in maps, which can greatly affect fps on slow machines. Must be a power of 2: 4 is the default, 8 is recommended for people on slow machines, 2 is nice for fast machines, a
